main_source.raw_certificate_retention: One JSONL record at a time; retain reduced per-repeat statistics only
main_source.stratification_source: NEW_HOLDOUT_PROTOCOL_CN.txt: public index/family rotation; no private data read

auxiliary_source.raw_certificate_retention: One JSONL record at a time; retain reduced per-repeat statistics only
auxiliary_source.stratification_source: NEW_HOLDOUT_PROTOCOL_CN.txt: public index/family rotation; no private data read

integrity.selection: Full structured main rep0 only; all auxiliary rows, each rep0

definitions.case_time: One timed run: full structured main rep0; auxiliary sturm/sparse rep0
definitions.within_budget_all: The single selected run resolves nonvacuously within its budget
definitions.speed_eligibility: Both all-repeat within-budget; both repeat statuses stable; same decision; not common quick; no conflicting certified decisions on that case
definitions.common_quick: Both methods resolve through shared quick gate in every repeat
definitions.speed_ratio: Baseline case-median seconds / candidate case-median seconds; >1 favors candidate
definitions.slowdown: Candidate case-median seconds >1.05 times baseline, on eligible solved subset
definitions.all_task_cost: Sum of case-median wall times, including UNKNOWN, late certificates and errors; not solve speedup
definitions.threshold_policy: Difficulty design only: numerical-reference margins are not safety truth labels
definitions.exclusions: Explicit and nonexclusive; no cases omitted from all-task costs or solve rates
definitions.separate_run_tags: Fixed cases are paired across separate run tags. Execution-order or machine-state drift between tags is not estimated. No repeat-level or population confidence claim is made.

bootstrap.interval: Percentile [2.5,97.5]; paired case resampling with replacement after within-case median reduction
bootstrap.unit: Case, never individual repeat; eligible-time intervals resample fixed eligible subset
bootstrap.scope: Descriptive variability of this fixed suite; not population inference or repeat-level timing uncertainty
bootstrap.multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or multiplicity-adjusted inferential claims
bootstrap.rng: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([fixed_seed, SHA256(context) first 8 bytes little-endian])
